subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 4 8 2 8 2 3 8 3 1 3 9 1 7 3 9 7 6 2 6 6 6 8 2 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 4 8 2 8 2 3 8 3 1 3 9 1 7 3 9 7 6 2 6 6 6 8 2 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Even — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dd9a847aca04fd29e20cf0a3a12e0607e936b825025faeb9dbbcc193a0841ec.png] 

Thus, there is one even number, each of which is immediately preceded by an even number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
